name: function-nil-return-test-762593be2f/function-nil-return-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed; object-constructor expressions are not listed.
## Module-level declarations: "Class definition" supports "remote-method-defn for client classes and resource-method-defn for service classes".
reason: The case asserts missing-return diagnostics and permitted implicit nil returns across many return types. Its service object constructor contains a remote method whose missing return is explicitly asserted with @error. Object-constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list, so this asserted behavior requires an uncovered construct even though ordinary return checking is in scope.
unsupported_constructs: Service object constructor expression: service object { remote function foo() returns int? { ... } }
test_design_notes: This is a negative compilation case with @error annotations, plus unannotated functions asserting acceptance of implicit nil returns.
The object-constructor method is part of the asserted diagnostics, not incidental instrumentation.
